text.en:
Amendment of Section I' of Executive Order No. 657 (s. 2007)
- Section | of Executive Order No. 657 (s.2007) is hereby amended to read as
"The Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission shall now be composed
of the following:
The President
The Deputy Executive Secretary for
Finance and Administration
The National Security Adviser
The Secretary of the Interior and Local
Vice-Chairman
POMA Hologram * 48897

Government
The Secretary of Justice
The Secretary of National Defense
The Secretary of Transportation
and Communications
'The Secretary of Foreign Affairs
Four (4) representatives from the Private
Sector to be appointed by the President
The President may designate a Co-Vice-Chairman from among the
members representing the private sector."

Repealing Clause. All issuances or portions thereof which are
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby revoked, amended or modified
accordingly.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 14t _ day of May, in the year of Our Lord,
Two Thousand and Nine.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
PORA Hologram * 48898
